item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory supply-inadequacy determination concerning lean beef trimmings, a substantive predicate for exercising the tariff-rate-quota authority; the consequence occurs in this segment upon the determination.","evidence":"determine that the supply of lean beef trimmings or directly competitive or substitutable agricultural products will be inadequate"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory necessity-and-appropriateness determination for a temporary quota increase; this presidential determination occurs immediately, rather than directing an agency to decide the result later.","evidence":"I determine that it is necessary and appropriate to temporarily increase the quantity of imports of lean beef trimmings"},{"segment_id":"3","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently determines the country allocation for the increased quota quantity, a legally consequential allocation determination; the remaining text merely recites statutory authority.","evidence":"I determine that it is appropriate to allocate all of the increased in-quota quantity of beef, as established by this proclamation, to Argentina."},{"segment_id":"4","code":3,"rationale":"The President directly increases and limits the tariff-rate quota, establishes its administration periods, allocates it to Argentina, and modifies the HTSUS; those legal consequences are effected by the proclamation itself.","evidence":"the HTSUS is modified as set forth in the Annex to this proclamation."},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"The President assigns the Trade Representative, after consultation with CBP, discretion to assess whether further HTSUS modifications are needed; no specified modification is imposed by this segment.","evidence":"shall determine whether any additional modifications to the HTSUS are necessary"},{"segment_id":"6","code":2,"rationale":"The Trade Representative must later make the HTSUS modifications found necessary through Federal Register notice, producing the consequential tariff-schedule changes through later official action; the segment also assigns Agriculture monitoring and advisory duties.","evidence":"shall make such modifications to the HTSUS through notice in the Federal Register"},{"segment_id":"7","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretary of Agriculture must report circumstances and recommend possible further presidential action, which is internal monitoring and advice rather than a prescribed legal consequence.","evidence":"shall recommend to me any additional action I should take, if necessary."},{"segment_id":"8","code":1,"rationale":"Read with its continued phrase in the next segment, this authorizes and directs executive departments and agencies to undertake appropriate implementation within their existing authority, without dictating a distinct legal outcome.","evidence":"Each executive department and agency (agency) is authorized to and"},{"segment_id":"9","code":1,"rationale":"Agencies are directed to implement the proclamation using appropriate measures, agency heads may internally redelegate functions, and inconsistent prior presidential directives are superseded as administrative housekeeping; no new external legal consequence is specified here.","evidence":"shall take all appropriate measures within its authority to implement this proclamation."}]}
